title: Fund
description: A fund held by the strata corporation, such as the operating fund or the contingency reserve fund (CRF).
x-validationRules: balanceDate is required when balance is present.
A strata corporation should have exactly one operating fund and one contingency reserve fund.
x-legalReviewNotes: Fund definitions summarise the Strata Property Act; legal review required before marking stable.

id.description: Stable identifier of this Fund record.

strataCorporationId.description: The strata corporation this record belongs to.

x-enumDescriptions.operating: Operating fund, for common expenses that usually occur once a year or more often.
x-enumDescriptions.contingencyReserve: Contingency reserve fund (CRF), for common expenses that usually occur less often than once a year or that do not usually occur.
x-enumDescriptions.specialLevy: Money raised by a special levy and held for its approved purpose.

extensions.description: Implementation-specific data, namespaced by reverse domain.
